notes: New Auto AP Placement: right-click an area (or Auto > Auto AP Placement) and Eagleview places the Access Points it needs, from coverage and capacity, around the APs you already have
The placed APs come from your AP Template with Tx Power and channels planned; one Undo takes them back
Every placement rule is a setting you can adjust (autoplace.json)
Draw a Wall > Wall Type > Edit dB Values: set this project's own dB for any wall type (used by drawn walls, Export Ekahau and Auto AP Placement)
